subject: Workshop handoff: consolidated notes, owners, and delivery plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme.com>, Tom Greer <tom.greer@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Workshop handoff: consolidated notes, owners, and delivery plan

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for hosting the exec workshop yesterday. Per our wrap, attached is a first-pass digest of the meeting notes and the action owner export (CSV) so you can pick this up on your side: redwood_acme_note-digest.pdf (summary + decision log) and acme_action_owners_v1.csv (owner, due, status).

What I would like from everyone this week:
- Internal: Marcus/Monica, please confirm the owner rows that map to Redwood deliverables and flag any items you need more context on.
- Acme: Sarah/Tom, can you confirm the procurement contact and whether you want us to route handoffs to procure@acme.com or to Tom directly?

Tentative timeline:
- Today: share notes and owner table (attached).
- Tue (5/18): final owner confirmations and Drive link delivery.
- Wed (5/19): Redwood delivers the technical appendix and kickoff for the pilot route.

I'm attaching the files and adding a Drive folder link for the living action matrix — please avoid editing the PDF and use the CSV for owner updates.

Thanks — short ask: Marcus/Monica, can you each reply with your confirmed owners by EOD Tuesday (5/18)?

Best,
Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park | Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Greer <tom.greer@acme.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Workshop handoff: consolidated notes, owners, and delivery plan

Kimberly — thanks for circulating this so quickly. The digest is helpful and the action CSV looks close to what we discussed. A few quick items from Acme's side: 

- Procurement: yes, please loop procure@acme.com for any contractual or SOW next steps. I'll copy Tom to ensure that we have the right contact.
- Priorities: we want the data residency and SLA items marked as high priority (rows 3, 7, 12 in your CSV).
- Can Redwood add a brief note column for "business impact" in the next export? That will make it easier for our steering committee to triage.

Also, Tom may push a change in owner for the infra checklist — I'll let him call that out in a follow-up.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Cheers,
Sarah
Sarah Lim | Director, Platform Engineering, Acme Corporation
sarah.lim@acme.com | +1 617-555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Workshop handoff: consolidated notes, owners, and delivery plan

Thanks, Kim / Sarah. I reviewed the CSV and mapped Redwood owners to each row — see inline here.

[Inline summary — owner confirmations]
- Row 3 (Data residency): Owner = Marcus Lin (Redwood infra), due 2027-06-02, priority = high. Action: prepare architecture sketch + KMS integration notes.
- Row 7 (SLA window): Owner = Monica Patel (Redwood SRE), due 2027-05-28, priority = high. Action: propose measurable latency SLOs and fallback policy.
- Row 12 (Pilot metrics): Owner = Marcus Lin, due 2027-06-09, priority = medium. Action: define telemetry events and reporting cadence.

I also added a quick "redwood_input_needed" column in the CSV and flagged three items where we need Acme clarification (listed as "need clarification"). Per Sarah's ask, we'll add a 1-line "business impact" column in the next pass.

Kimberly — I'll sync with Monica on Monday to ensure the SRE comments are explicit in the Drive matrix.

On the procurement routing: happy to include procure@acme.com but recommend we keep Tom copied for approvals.

-Marcus

--
Marcus Lin | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme.com>, Tom Greer <tom.greer@acme.com>, procure@acme.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized handoff + living action matrix link (please confirm owners)

Folks —

Thanks for the quick responses. I've consolidated Marcus's owner confirmations into the living Action Matrix in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink (folder: ACME-Exec-Workshop/Action-Matrix).

What's in the folder now:
- action_matrix_v2.csv (master owner table with "business impact" and "redwood_input_needed" columns)
- redwood_acme_note-digest.pdf (read-only summary)
- tech_appendix_draft.docx (initial infra appendix — Redwood to finalize after owners confirm)

Next steps: 
- Marcus/Monica: please review action_matrix_v2.csv and hit the "confirm" cell for each row assigned to Redwood by EOD Thursday (5/20).
- Sarah/Tom/Procure: if procurement wants any contract language flagged before we open SOW conversations, please add comments directly on the Drive doc or reply-all with the notes.

I'll run a short internal sync on Friday to bundle the technical appendix and proposed SOW outline for Acme. If anyone needs the matrix exported as XLSX for internal systems, let me know and I will attach it.

Thanks — goal is to have owners confirmed and appendix draft ready to share with procurement next week.

Best,
Kimberly
